posts.title: Radxa ROCK 3A
posts.description: This embedded board fell on my lap: Radxa ROCK 3A CPU: ARM5 Quad Cortex-A55, up to 2GHz Video: Mali-G32 GPU HDMI, 4k video decode RAM: LPDDR4 Buses: PCIe 3.0, SATA 3.0 sockets: eMMC, M.2, USB 3.0 x2, USB 2.? x2, Ethernet RJ-45 Radxa.com doc shows the following: Model Radxa ROCK 3A SoC Rockchip rk3568 CPU Quad-core Cortex-A55, up to 2GHz GPU Arm MaliTM G52 2EE, Supports Arm MaliTM G52 2EE, OpenGL ES1.1/2.0/3.2, Vulkan 1.1, OpenCLTM 2.0 Memory 1/2/4/8 GB LPDDR4 Storage On-board eMMC module: 0/8/16/32/64 GB MicroSD Memory Card Show Micro HDMI interface: Supports 4K@60fps output 1x2 lane MIPI DSI Ethernet Gigabit Ethernet with Power over Ethernet (PoE) support PoE requires additional optional HAT Wireless communication M.2 E Key supports external Radxa Wireless Module A8 (Wi-Fi 6 & BT 5.2) USB 2x USB 2.0 HOST ports 1x USB 3.0 HOST port 1x USB 3.0 OTG/HOST port camera 1x2 lane MIPI CSI Other 40-pin expansion seat Power supply Requires 5V/2A power adapter Dimensions 65mm x 30mm
